name: Trade Transaction Condition 2 Code
definition: Specifies the conditions under which the order/trade is to be executed.

SPCC.name: Special Cum Coupon
SPCC.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special cum coupon.

SECN.name: Special Ex Coupon
SECN.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special ex coupon.

SEBN.name: Special Ex Bonus
SEBN.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special ex bonus.

SCBN.name: Special Cum Bonus
SCBN.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special cum bonus.

SCRT.name: Special Cum Rights
SCRT.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special cum rights.

SERT.name: Special Ex Rights
SERT.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special ex rights.

SCCR.name: Special Cum Capital Repayments
SCCR.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special cum capital repayments.

SECR.name: Special Ex Capital Repayments
SECR.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special ex capital repayments.

CAST.name: Cash Settlement
CAST.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a cash settlement.

SPPR.name: Special Price
SPPR.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special price.

SPCU.name: Special Cum Dividend
SPCU.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special cum |dividend, that is, buying after the ex date and getting the dividend.

SPEX.name: Special Ex Dividend
SPEX.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special ex |dividend, that is, selling before the ex date without the coupon.

GTDL.name: Guaranteed Delivery
GTDL.definition: Indicates whether the delivery of the financial instrument on settlement date |is guaranteed.
